_comment: Map SensorPush devices to active batch IDs. The poller authenticates with SENSORPUSH_EMAIL + SENSORPUSH_PASSWORD env vars, queries available sensors, then for each entry below pulls the latest sample every interval_seconds and writes it as a 'sensor' event on the batch.
_install_path: Place at ~/Library/Application Support/crowe-terminal/sensorpush-map.json (the daemon reads this path by default).
_sensor_field: Match against the SensorPush device display name OR its raw id. The daemon prints both at startup so you can copy the right value.
_batch_id_field: Use crowe-farm list to find current batch IDs. Update the mapping when batches finish/cull/move rooms.
